jmdict_l1.key_correction: First detector (reading-only) gave 494 false-heavy flags and would have REPLACED correct kanji-word glosses with wrong-homophone ones. Fixed: kanji words are pinned by their kanji form. Lesson: inspect before any deterministic apply.
jmdict_l1.do_not: Do NOT auto-rewrite gloss. The top-priority pick is itself wrong ~half the time for kana homophones (e.g. こと->'koto zither'). There is no free deterministic semantic disambiguation.
jmdict_l1.how_used: Exporter adds gs (provenance) + gj (JMdict candidate senses). gs=jmdict_entry_matched proves the gloss belongs to the word's JMdict entry, but contextual sense selection is still reviewed. Other statuses must not be trusted blindly.
